name: Applied Mathematics for Thermofluids
description: Theory of linear homogeneous and nonhomogeneous ODEs; series solutions of linear ODEs; systems of ODEs; vector space, basis vectors, eigen value and eigen vectors; functions space, basis functions, scalar products, norm, special functions, Fourier series; linear differential operators, operator eigenvalue problems, Sturm-Liouville theory; 1st order PDEs, method of characteristics; classification of 2nd order PDEs, hyperbolic, parabolic and elliptic PDEs; method of separation of variables, solutions of 1-D wave equation, unsteady heat equations and Laplace’s equation; eigen function expansion method for non-homogeneous PDEs, solution of heat equation in 2D and 3D, linear stability analysis.
